voice_platform_post.bodyShape: { action: <action name>, input: <action fields> }. actor is server supplied and must not be supplied by the client.

create_consent.notes: Only actual consent evidence; never invent evidence.

add_target.notes: transcriptConsent must be true and backed by actual consent

set_runtime_settings.notes: All booleans replace stored flags; omitted means false. Enabling customer calls requires explicit user authorization and confirmation KUNDENANRUFE FREIGEBEN.

resolve_provider_uncertainty.notes: confirmed_no_call requires actual provider verification and PROVIDER GEPRUEFT KEIN CALL. close_without_retry requires PROVIDER FALL SCHLIESSEN.

approve_model_sandbox.notes: Explicit authorization required; confirmation SANDBOX-MODELL FREIGEBEN.

promote_model.notes: Explicit authorization required; confirmation PRODUKTIONSMODELL FREIGEBEN.

record_evaluation.notes: Actual evaluation evidence only. scenarioCount integer >=50; passedCount integer 0..scenarioCount.

company_brain_actions_post.confirmationRequirements: confirmed=true and confirmationText='Freigabe' only after explicit user authorization for the concrete action. Governance may return a pending approval run rather than execution; inspect the returned status and use approvalRunId/approvalNote after the required review. operatorName is derived from the authenticated actor.

company_brain_trello_aliases_post.confirmationRequirements: confirmed=true and confirmationText='Freigabe' only after explicit approval for the proposed alias repair.

dunning_orderKey_actions_post.confirmationRequirements: For every irreversible action first load its preview; use the returned exact confirmationPhrase, snapshot hash, expected stage and stable idempotency key only after the user's concrete approval. Enqueue uses 'VORMERKEN '+the actual orderNumber. Never infer successful payment or court submission.

voice_phone_team_post.bodyShape: { action, staffId, values?, revision?, relatedId? }. Values are a full profile for create/update. This manages staff profiles, invitations and enrolled devices; it does not impersonate a phone or register audio.

create.notes: staffId is a new UUID; values.displayName string 2..100, values.enabled boolean, optional values.accessEmail email or null and values.extension 1..6 digits or null. No other values fields allowed.

update.notes: Use the existing staff UUID and integer revision >=1 returned by voice_phone_team_get. Same complete values as create; omission clears optional email/extension. Stale revision, duplicate email/extension, and manager self-lockout are rejected.

issue_invite.notes: Returns a one-time enrollment code. Treat it as a secret; do not place it in logs or general reports. Real browser enrollment remains in the Phone UI.

revoke_invite.notes: relatedId is the invite UUID returned by voice_phone_team_get.

revoke_device.notes: relatedId is the device UUID returned by voice_phone_team_get. Revokes that personal device.

voice_phone_team_post.authorization: VOICE_PHONE_ENABLED plus an explicitly active, unexpired voice_management_service_actors mapping for the verified Cloudflare principal to an enabled voice_staff row with can_manage_phone=true. No role escalation or implicit grant. Roles/access policy themselves are provisioned outside this staff API.

voice_phone_team_get.authorization: VOICE_PHONE_ENABLED plus an explicitly active, unexpired voice_management_service_actors mapping for the verified Cloudflare principal to an enabled voice_staff row with can_manage_phone=true. No role escalation or implicit grant. Roles/access policy themselves are provisioned outside this staff API.
voice_phone_team_get.responseNotes: Managed staff, revision, invites and devices. Use this read before any update/revoke. Does not expose invitation token hashes or personal device cookies.

resultLimits.pagination: offset (non-negative integer), limit (positive integer); for plain arrays continue offset += returned length until an empty page; no transactional snapshot across requests
resultLimits.notes: scope defaults active. q/supplier prefilter the SQL query; complete literal q, urgency and active visibility apply before globally sorted pagination. board.pagination.total/nextOffset describe the chosen scope. board.counts cover all non-completed rows matching q/supplier/payment/urgency, independently of scope; priorPaidCustomerOpen is best-effort historical enrichment. Source and item/event scans use pages of 500 up to 100000 rows, 25s budget and fail closed on incomplete/changed reads. Response size/timeout limits still apply; reduce limit for large item payloads.

resultLimits.pagination: offset (non-negative integer), limit (positive integer); for plain arrays continue offset += returned length until an empty page; no transactional snapshot across requests
resultLimits.notes: status open/in_progress/waiting/done/archived/all overrides includeDone. Without status, includeDone=1 includes completed; defaults retain the working queue. assignee, requestId and sourceRef filters available. summary describes only the returned page, not all tasks. Legacy status filtering scans until requested page or EOF, bounded to 100000 source rows and 25s; failure is explicit.

resultLimits.pagination: mode=requests or mode=history; offset/limit; pagination.nextOffset=null marks EOF; bounded 25s read and explicit errors, no transactional snapshot
resultLimits.notes: Default search (10), inbox (6) and workboard (4 per section) remain bounded UI previews and declare preview.complete=false. mode=requests enumerates every NEONTRIP master_request via canonical customer FK, with customerId/requestId/query/status filters before paging; query supports name/company, email, phone, request:<external ID>, deal:/ac:, trello: or a Trello URL. mode=history requires external requestId and source: offers/orders/email_orders/sales/quotes/email_quotes/calls/voice_calls/followups/plans/documents/communications/quote_emails/outlook/outlook_organization/inbound_emails/audits/quote_versions/quote_version_images/related_customers. Histories bind to request/customer/contact matches (bindingScope stated), use fixed safe field projections and deterministic order; outlook_organization is the explicitly separate corporate-domain match. available=false/schema_unavailable is an unavailable source, never proof of no history. No arbitrary tables, raw metadata, tokens or provider errors. Use canonical offers tools for offer links/details. Unknown modes/keys/sources reject 422. Reduce limit on gateway payload limits.

resultLimits.pagination: collection=<allowlisted name>, limit/offset; pagination.hasMore/nextOffset; no transactional snapshot
resultLimits.notes: No query preserves the bounded dashboard (50/100 per collection). Complete alternatives: models(lifecycle,evalStatus,enabled), evaluations(modelReleaseId,status), prompts(mode,status), campaigns(mode,status,promptVersionId), targets(campaignId,requestId,offerId,consentId,status), attempts(targetId,modelReleaseId,promptVersionId,status), outcomes(attemptId,outcomeCode), allowlist(phone,enabled), consents(requestId,phone,status). Every collection also accepts id. Filters are exact and applied before paging. Unknown collection/filter and filters without collection reject 422. Disabled feature/missing schema report enabled/storageReady flags; not an empty complete archive. Rows use existing staff projections; no runtime worker action or consent mutation.
